questions.prompt: Three players. A is all-in for $10, B and C each put in $50. A can win…

choices.text: Only the main pot of $30, if A has the best hand.

questions.explanation: A contributed $10 and is matched by $10 from each of the others.

questions.prompt: B and C continue after A is all-in. Their extra $40 each is…

choices.text: A side pot only B and C can win.

questions.explanation: The side pot is contested by the players who put that money in.

questions.prompt: Before calling a river bet, you should know…

choices.text: The price and the pot you are calling into.

questions.explanation: The call amount and the pot size are the minimum facts for pot odds.

questions.prompt: If the board plays and two live players tie…

choices.text: They split the pots they are both eligible for.

questions.explanation: Ties split that pot. Side-pot eligibility still applies.
